```{r load preprocessed dataset}
raw <- read.csv("../data/formal/formal-full-data-preprocessed.csv")
raw$rt.log = log(raw$rt)
raw <- raw |> 
  rename(label_type = 'Spreadsheet..label')
```

```{r sanity check of experiment setup}

#check counterbalanced list assignment
sum.list.assign <- raw %>%
  group_by(list) %>%
  summarise(n_subjects = n_distinct(ID))

#check exposure condition assignment
sum.condition.assign <- raw %>%
  filter(condition!="") %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n_subjects = n_distinct(ID))

#check trial number in each exposure and test blocks
sum.trial.num <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch") %>% 
  group_by(ID, blockID) %>% 
  summarise(
    trial_num = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = blockID, 
    values_from = trial_num
  )

```

```{r participant-level check and exclusion}

# (1) check catch trial accuracy
sum.catch_accuracy <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type == "catch") %>% 
  mutate(catch.corr = if_else(word == Response, 1, 0)) %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_catch = n(),
    accuracy = mean(catch.corr),
    exclude.catch  = accuracy < 0.83
  )

data.exclude.catch.low.acc <- sum.catch_accuracy %>% 
  filter(exclude.catch == TRUE)%>% 
  distinct(ID)


# (2) check labelled trial accuracy
sum.labelled_accuracy <- raw %>%
  filter(label_type == "labeled") %>% 
  mutate(label.corr = if_else(word == Response, 1, 0)) %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_labelled = n(),
    accuracy = mean(label.corr),
    exclude.labelled  = accuracy < 0.94
  )

data.exclude.labelled.low.acc <- sum.labelled_accuracy %>% 
  filter(exclude.labelled == TRUE)%>% 
  distinct(ID)


# (3a) check valid responses across participants
sum.resp.num <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch", !is.na(resp.num)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    resp.num = sum(!is.na(resp.num)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# (3b) check NA responses across participants
sum.na.resp <- raw %>% 
  filter(trial_type != "catch", is.na(resp.num)) %>% 
  count(ID, name = "na_count") %>%
  mutate(
    exclude.high.na = na_count > 21
  )

data.exclude.high.na <- sum.na.resp %>% 
  filter(exclude.high.na == TRUE)%>% 
  distinct(ID)


# (4) check overall RT across participants
sum.subj.RT <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch") %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    trial_num = n(),
    subj_mean_RT = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    subj_mean_RT.log = mean(rt.log, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    subj_mean_RT.log.z = as.numeric(scale(subj_mean_RT.log)),
    exclude.by.subj.rt = abs(subj_mean_RT.log.z) > 3
  )

data.exclude.by.subj.rt <- sum.subj.RT |> 
  filter(exclude.by.subj.rt == TRUE)%>% 
  distinct(ID)


# (5) check atypical categorization responses based on T1 block
# note that each VOT token appeared in a test block only once
sum.cat.diff <- raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch", blockID == "T5") %>%
  mutate(
    vot_group = case_when(
      VOT <= 30 ~ "short_VOT", #bin responses for VOT= −5, 5, 15, 25, 30 together
      VOT >= 45 ~ "long_VOT",  #bin responses for VOT= 45, 50, 55, 65, 70 together
      TRUE ~ "middle_VOT"      #set aside VOT= 35, 40 which might be in the ambiguous region
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(vot_group != "middle_VOT") %>%
  group_by(ID, vot_group) %>%
  summarise(mean_resp = mean(resp.num, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = vot_group, values_from = mean_resp) %>%
  mutate(
    category_diff = long_VOT - short_VOT,
    exclude.atypical.cat = category_diff <= 0.3
  )

flagged.atypical.cat.ids <- sum.cat.diff |> 
  filter(exclude.atypical.cat == TRUE) %>% 
  distinct(ID) %>%
  pull(ID)

# check performance in the T1 block for flagged ids
raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch", blockID == "T5") %>%
  filter(ID %in% flagged.atypical.cat.ids) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VOT, y = resp.num)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick") +
  facet_wrap(~ID, ncol = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Visualizing 14 Flagged Atypical Participants (T1)",
    subtitle = "Check if they are true flat lines/random guessers or just shallower slopes",
    x = "VOT (ms)",
    y = "Proportion of /t/ Response"
  )

# check performance averaged across all blocks for flagged ids
raw %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch") %>%
  filter(ID %in% flagged.atypical.cat.ids) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VOT, y = resp.num)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "firebrick") +
  facet_wrap(~ID, ncol = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Visualizing 14 Flagged Atypical Participants (all blocks)",
    subtitle = "Check if they are true flat lines/random guessers or just shallower slopes",
    x = "VOT (ms)",
    y = "Proportion of /t/ Response"
  )

exclude_ids <- bind_rows(
  data.exclude.catch.low.acc,
  data.exclude.labelled.low.acc,
  data.exclude.high.na,
  data.exclude.by.subj.rt
) %>% 
  pull(ID) %>% 
  unique()

unique(exclude_ids)
length(unique(exclude_ids))

raw.subj.exclu <- raw %>% 
  filter(!ID %in% exclude_ids)

n_distinct(raw$ID) #N=129 originally
n_distinct(raw.subj.exclu$ID) #N=121 after exclusion

```

```{r trial-level check and exclusion}

#check within-subject RT
raw.subj.exclu.trim.trial <- raw.subj.exclu |> 
   group_by(ID) |> 
   mutate(
     within.subj.rt.log.z = as.numeric(scale(rt.log)),
     exclude.trial.rt = abs(within.subj.rt.log.z) > 3
     ) |>
   ungroup()

table(raw.subj.exclu.trim.trial$exclude.trial.rt) #287/28314=1.01%
```

```{r}

participant.condition <- df_final %>%
  filter(condition != "") %>%
  distinct(ID, condition)

data.plot <- df_final %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch") %>%
 # left_join(participant.condition, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(blockID = factor(blockID, levels = c("T1","A","T2","B","T3","C","T4","T5","T6")), ID = factor(ID)) %>%
  group_by(ID, blockID) %>%
  summarise(mean.prop = mean(resp.num), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(data.plot, aes(blockID, mean.prop, colour = ID, group = ID)) +

  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Block", y = "Proportion /t/")

```

```{r}

#prepare dataset for crticial trials
df.critical.trial <- df_final %>%
  filter(trial_type != "catch", !is.na(resp.num)) %>%
 # left_join(participant.condition, by = "ID") %>%
  mutate(ID = as.factor(ID)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  mutate(
    block_order = match(blockID, unique(blockID)),
    
    exp_stageID = c("Test 1", "Exposure 1", 
                         "Test 2", "Exposure 2", 
                         "Test 3", "Exposure 3", 
                         "Test 4", "Test 5", "Test 6")[block_order],
  ) %>%
  ungroup()  %>%
  mutate(
    exp_stageID = factor(
      exp_stageID, 
      levels = c("Test 1", "Exposure 1", 
                 "Test 2", "Exposure 2", 
                 "Test 3", "Exposure 3", 
                 "Test 4", "Test 5", "Test 6")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !str_detect(exp_stageID, "Exposure") | 
    (str_detect(exp_stageID, "Exposure") & label_type == "unlabeled")
  )
  #for exposure blocks, only unlabeled trials were included for analysis


#separate exposure and test dataset
df_exposure <- df.critical.trial %>% 
  filter(str_detect(trial_type, "exposure"))

df_test <- df.critical.trial %>% 
  filter(str_detect(trial_type, "test"))


hist(df_exposure$rt, breaks=50)
hist(df_test$rt, breaks=50)

```
```{r}

# categorization response by participants
ggplot(data=df.critical.trial, aes(x=VOT, y=resp.num, colour = ID, group = ID)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", 
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.8, height = 0.02), size=1.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", alpha = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~ exp_stageID) +
  labs(x = "VOT (ms)", y = "Proportion /t/") +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r exposure blocks PSE}

#full glm model
fit_exposure <- glmer(
  resp.num ~ VOT * exp_stageID * participant.condition + 
    (1 + VOT | ID) + (1 | stim),
  data = df_exposure,
  family = binomial,
  nAGQ = 0,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"),
  verbose = 1
  )

summary(fit_exposure)


#establish predictions for response proportion by VOT, block, and exposure condition
#exposure_preds <- emmeans(
#  fit_exposure, 
#  ~ VOT | exp_stageID * participant.condition,
#  at = list(VOT = seq(-20, 120, by = 0.1)),
#  type = "response",
#  rg.limit = 40000
#) %>% 
#  as.data.frame()


#derive PSE from the VOT value that corresponds to ~p=0.5
#pse_exposure <- exposure_preds %>%
#  group_by(exp_stageID, participant.condition) %>%
#  filter(abs(prob - 0.5) == min(abs(prob - 0.5))) %>%
#  rename(PSE = VOT) %>%
#  ungroup()


#subj-level PSE
exposure_subj_info <- df_exposure %>% 
  distinct(ID, participant.condition)

exposure_subj <- expand_grid(
  exposure_subj_info,
  exp_stageID = unique(df_exposure$exp_stageID),
  VOT = seq(-20, 125, by = 0.1)
)

exposure_subj$prob <- predict(fit_exposure, newdata = exposure_subj, type = "response", re.form = ~ (1 + VOT | ID))

exposure_subj_pse <- exposure_subj %>%
  group_by(ID, exp_stageID, participant.condition) %>%
  filter(abs(prob - 0.5) == min(abs(prob - 0.5))) %>%
  summarise(PSE_subj = mean(VOT), .groups = "drop")

exposure_pse_group_ci <- exposure_subj_pse %>% #get CI from group mean
  group_by(exp_stageID, participant.condition) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    PSE = mean(PSE_subj, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(PSE_subj, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = SD / sqrt(N),
    PSE_grouplowerCI = PSE - 1.96 * SE,
    PSE_groupupperCI = PSE + 1.96 * SE,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

#visualize model-predicted caetgorization curves
```{r model-predicted categorization curve for exposure blocks}

#establish grid for model prediction (vot x exposure condition x block)
exposure_vots <- seq(min(df_exposure$VOT, na.rm=TRUE), max(df_exposure$VOT, na.rm=TRUE), by = 0.5)
exposure_conditions <- unique(df_exposure$participant.condition)
exposure_stages <- unique(df_exposure$exp_stageID)

exposure_pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  VOT = exposure_vots,
  participant.condition = exposure_conditions,
  exp_stageID = exposure_stages
)

#log-odds prediction
exposure_pred_logodds <- predict(
  fit_exposure, 
  newdata = exposure_pred_grid, 
  re.form = NA, 
  se.fit = TRUE
)

#convert log-odds back to probability
exposure_pred_grid <- exposure_pred_grid %>%
  mutate(
    fit_logodds = exposure_pred_logodds$fit,
    se_logodds = exposure_pred_logodds$se.fit,
    pred_resp = plogis(fit_logodds),
    conf.low = plogis(fit_logodds - 1.96 * se_logodds),
    conf.high = plogis(fit_logodds + 1.96 * se_logodds)
  )


exposure_pred_curves <- ggplot() +
  stat_summary(
    data = df.subject.mean %>% filter(exp_stageID %in% exposure_stages),
    aes(x = VOT, y = resp.num, color = participant.condition),
    fun = mean, 
    geom = "point", 
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = exposure_pred_grid,
    aes(x = VOT, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = participant.condition),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = exposure_pred_grid,
    aes(x = VOT, y = pred_resp, color = participant.condition),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("expo-20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo+20ms"),
    values = c("expo-20ms" = "#D32F2F", "expo-10ms" = "#2E7D32", "expo+20ms" = "#1E88E5")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("expo-20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo+20ms"),
    values = c("expo-20ms" = "#D32F2F", "expo-10ms" = "#2E7D32", "expo+20ms" = "#1E88E5")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ exp_stageID) +
  labs(
    x = "VOT (ms)", 
    y = "Proportion /t/",
    title = "Model-Fitted Categorization Curves (Exposure Blocks)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
  )

print(exposure_pred_curves)

```

```{r combine plots - B}
ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = all_pred_grid_B %>% filter(!is.na(exp_stageID)),
    aes(x = VOT, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = participant.condition),
    alpha = 0.15, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = all_pred_grid_B %>% filter(!is.na(exp_stageID)),
    aes(x = VOT, y = pred_resp, color = participant.condition),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    data = df.subject.mean_B %>% filter(!is.na(exp_stageID)),
    aes(x = VOT, y = resp.num, color = participant.condition),
    fun = mean, geom = "point", alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("expo-20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo+20ms"),
    values = c("expo-20ms" = "#D32F2F", "expo-10ms" = "#2E7D32", "expo+20ms" = "#1E88E5")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("expo-20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo+20ms"),
    values = c("expo-20ms" = "#D32F2F", "expo-10ms" = "#2E7D32", "expo+20ms" = "#1E88E5")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ exp_stageID, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

```

#visualize proportion of adaptation
```{r define expected learning in idealized listeners' based on TJ2025, Figure S6}

baseline_prior <- 44.53 #roughly

baseline_test1 <- test_pse_group_ci %>%
  filter(exp_stageID == "Test 1") %>%
  dplyr::select(participant.condition, PSE_test1 = PSE) #use as baseline to calculate proportion of adaptation

#exposure
ideal_exposure <- tibble(
  participant.condition = c("expo+20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo-20ms"),
  expected_pse_exposure = c(64.49, 34.35, 24.83)
)

#test
ideal_test <- tibble(
  participant.condition = c("expo+20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo-20ms"),
  expected_pse_test = c(64.59, 34.53, 24.49)
)

```

```{r proportion of adaptation (ideal shift endpoint measured against prior)- exposure and test blocks}

pse_exposure_with_pct.1 <- exposure_pse_group_ci %>%
  left_join(baseline_test1, by = "participant.condition") %>%
  left_join(ideal_exposure, by = "participant.condition") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = (PSE - PSE_test1) / (expected_pse_exposure - PSE_test1),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct * 100),
    block_type = "Exposure"
  )

pse_test_with_pct.1 <- test_pse_group_ci %>%
  left_join(baseline_test1, by = "participant.condition") %>%
  left_join(ideal_test, by = "participant.condition") %>%
  mutate(
    pct = (PSE - PSE_test1) / (expected_pse_test - PSE_test1),
    pct_label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct * 100),
    block_type = "Test"
  )


pse_combined_with_pct.1 <- bind_rows(pse_exposure_with_pct, pse_test_with_pct) %>%
  mutate(exp_stageID = factor(exp_stageID, levels = c(
    "Test 1", "Exposure 1", 
    "Test 2", "Exposure 2", 
    "Test 3", "Exposure 3", 
    "Test 4", "Test 5", "Test 6"
  ))) %>% 
  arrange(participant.condition, exp_stageID)

```


```{r proportion plot against ideal listeners (ideal shift endpoint measured against prior)}


# Idealized Learner (based on values in TJ2025-supplementary material-figureS6)
ideal_lines <- data.frame(
  participant.condition = c("expo+20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo-20ms"),
  yintercept = c(64.59, 34.53, 24.49),
  label = c("+21 (100%)\nidealized learner", 
            "-9 (100%)\nidealized learner", 
            "-18 (100%)\nidealized learner")
)


p_fig.idealbyPrior <- ggplot(pse_combined_with_pct.1, aes(x = exp_stageID, y = PSE, group = participant.condition, color = participant.condition)) +
  
  geom_rect(
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
    ymin = 43.53, ymax = 45.53,
    fill = "grey85", color = NA, alpha = 0.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_hline(
    data = ideal_lines, 
    aes(yintercept = yintercept, color = participant.condition),
    linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = ideal_lines,
    aes(x = Inf, y = yintercept, label = label, color = participant.condition),
    hjust = -0.15,
    vjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.2, 
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.85,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = PSE_grouplowerCI, ymax = PSE_groupupperCI),
    width = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(0.2)
  ) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  
  geom_label(
    data = filter(pse_combined_with_pct.1, exp_stageID != "Test 1"),
    aes(label = pct_label),
    vjust = -0.6,
    label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
    label.size = 0.2,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.85,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    position = position_dodge(0.2)
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c("expo-20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo+20ms"),
    values = c("expo-20ms" = "#D32F2F", "expo-10ms" = "#2E7D32", "expo+20ms" = "#1E88E5")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Block",
    y = "PSE (ms VOT)",
    title = "Perceptual Boundary Shift across Experimental Blocks",
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + 
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 85, b = 10, l = 10, unit = "pt"),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_fig.idealbyPrior)

```

```{r proportion of adaptation (ideal shift endpoint measured against test 1) - exposure and test blocks}

#consider ideal delta rather than fixed endpoints in FigS6
ideal_deltas <- tibble(
  participant.condition = c("expo+20ms", "expo-10ms", "expo-20ms"),
  ideal_delta = c(21, -9, -18)
)

pse_combined_with_pct.2 <- pse_combined_with_pct.1 %>%
  left_join(ideal_deltas, by = "participant.condition") %>%
  mutate(
    ideal_endpoint_from_test1 = PSE_test1 + ideal_delta,
    shift_from_test1 = PSE - PSE_test1,
    pct_by_ideal_endpoint_from_test1 = shift_from_test1 / ideal_delta
  )
```
